source: Ah, wait, before I forget! This mode includes a new big mechanic: PRANK DARES.
target: 啊,等等,在我忘记之前! 这个模式包括一个新的大机械师:PRANK DARES.

source: They're like missions to gain personal points for you to get better endings.
target: 他们就像任务 获得个人的分数 让你得到更好的结局。

source: We'll explain it in more detail in a minute.
target: 等会再详细解释

source: For now, choose a PRANK DARE:
target: 现在,选择一个PRANK DARE:

source: Ah, the road... that mythical beast of asphalt...
target: 啊，道路……那头由沥青铺成的神话巨兽……

source: We once tamed it in what became one of the strangest, most wonderful journeys of our lives...
target: 我们曾经驯服过它，踏上了人生中最离奇、最精彩的旅程之一……

source: ...back then, when we were young and unafraid.
target: ……那时，我们年轻，无所畏惧。

source: Summer was coming to an end when Polly and Scott planned a road trip.
target: 夏日将尽，波莉和斯科特计划来一场公路旅行。

source: The whole thing was bound to go off rails; this was the Prank Masterz, after all:
target: 整件事注定会彻底失控——毕竟，主谋可是这两位恶作剧大师：

source: Scott Howl (22), a werewolf athlete who compensated for his rather small brain with a stupidly huge heart.
target: 斯科特·豪尔（22 岁），狼人运动健将；脑容量虽小，却有一颗大得离谱的心。

source: And Polly Geist (23?), a party ghost with an insatiable hunger for all the wrong things.
target: 以及波莉·盖斯特（23 岁？），派对幽灵，对各种不该碰的东西都有着无穷无尽的渴望。

source: Each of them were, by themselves, an agent of chaos...
target: 单独看，他们每一个都是混乱的化身……

source: ...but together? Together, they were the perfect combo for hijinks to ensue.
target: ……可凑到一起呢？他们简直是胡闹惹事的完美组合。

source: Who in their right mind would have agreed to join them on such a trip?
target: 究竟哪个脑子正常的人，会答应和他们一起上路？

source: Was the road trip a dangerous idea? Yes.
target: 路途旅行是一个危险的主意吗? 对

source: Was it poorly planned? Yes.
target: 计划不周吗? 对

source: Did we do it anyway? Fuck yes.
target: 我们做了吗? 他妈的是的。

source: For in the end...
target: 因为最后...

source: ...we were young and unafraid...
target: ...我们年轻而无畏...

source: ...and we were ready to start.
target: ...我们准备开始了。
